2. The present bail application has been filed by the applicant in Case Crime No. 312 of 2022, under
Sections 452, 376(2)(Jha), 506 I.P.C. and Section 3/4(2) Pocso Act, Police Station Mandawar,
District Bijnor, with the prayer to enlarge the applicant on bail.

sentences.text:
The informant has lodged first information report on 02.11.2022,
alleging that on the night of 01.11.2022, applicant trespassed into his house and committed rape upon his minor daughter.

sentences.text: Though, the age of victim has been stated about 16 years but the attending facts and circumstances of the case show that she was a major girl.
sentences._hearing_file: Abhishek vs State Of U.P. And 3 Others on 22 May, 2023.json

sentences.text: Victim has not sustained any injury.
sentences._hearing_file: Abhishek vs State Of U.P. And 3 Others on 22 May, 2023.json

sentences.text: 4. It is further submitted that the statement of informant as well as of victim girl have already been recorded before the Trial Court.

sentences.text: In her statement before the Trial Court, the victim has stated her age as 20 years and she has stated that on the night of incident, applicant has come in her room but he has not pressed her mouth and he has not committed rape upon her.
sentences._hearing_file: Abhishek vs State Of U.P. And 3 Others on 22 May, 2023.json

sentences.text: She has also denied her statements, recorded under Sections 161 and 164 Cr.P.C.
sentences._hearing_file: Abhishek vs State Of U.P. And 3 Others on 22 May, 2023.json

sentences.text: In her cross-examination, she has denied the involvement of applicant in the incident.
sentences._hearing_file: Abhishek vs State Of U.P. And 3 Others on 22 May, 2023.json

sentences.text: It is further submitted that applicant is languishing in jail since 21.11.2022 and there are a number of formal witnesses, who are yet to be examined and thus, trial of the case would take sufficient long time.
sentences._hearing_file: Abhishek vs State Of U.P. And 3 Others on 22 May, 2023.json

sentences.text: Lastly, it was submitted that in case applicant is released on bail, he will not misuse the liberty of bail and will co-operate in trial.
sentences._hearing_file: Abhishek vs State Of U.P. And 3 Others on 22 May, 2023.json

sentences.text: 5. Learned counsel for the informant submits that as victim has not supported the prosecution version and turned hostile and thus, the bail application is not being opposed.

sentences.text:
6. Learned A.G.A. has opposed the prayer of bail, however, it could not be disputed that during trial,
victim has not supported the prosecution version.
sentences._hearing_file: Abhishek vs State Of U.P. And 3 Others on 22 May, 2023.json

sentences.text: 7. Considering the submissions of learned counsel for the parties, nature of accusations, period of custody and all attending facts and circumstances of the case, without expressing any opinion on the merits of the case, the Court is of the view that a case for bail is made out.
sentences._hearing_file: Abhishek vs State Of U.P. And 3 Others on 22 May, 2023.json

sentences.text: Hence, the bail application is hereby allowed.
sentences._hearing_file: Abhishek vs State Of U.P. And 3 Others on 22 May, 2023.json

sentences.text:
8. Let the applicant Abhishek, involved in aforesaid case crime, be released on bail on furnishing a personal bond and two sureties each in the like amount to the satisfaction of the court concerned subject to following conditions:
(i). The applicant shall not tamper with the evidence during the trial.
(ii). The applicant shall not pressurize/intimidate the prosecution witness.
(iii). The applicant shall appear before the Trial Court on the date fixed, unless personal presence is exempted.
(iv). The applicant shall not commit an offence similar to the offence of which he is accused, or suspected, of the commission of which he is suspected.
(v). The applicant shall not directly or indirectly make any inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade them from disclosing such facts to the Court or to any police officer or tamper with the evidence.

sentences.text: 1 Record shows that in respect of an incident which is alleged to have occurred on 27.8.2023 a belated F.I.R. dated 30.8.2023 was lodged by first informant Jeevan Ram and was registered as Case Crime No. 253 of 2023 under Sections 376 IPC, 3/4 POCSO Act, Police Station- Barkhera District- Pilibhit.
sentences._hearing_file: Abhishek vs State Of U.P. And 3 Others on 15 December, 2023.json

sentences.text: In the aforesaid F.I.R., applicant- Abhishek has been nominated as solitary named accused.
sentences._hearing_file: Abhishek vs State Of U.P. And 3 Others on 15 December, 2023.json

sentences.text: The gravamen of the allegations made in the F.I.R. is to the effect that on 27.8.2023 at around 9:00 am when the daughter of the first informant had gone in the field to attend the call of nature, named accused is alleged to have deliberately and forcibly committed sexual assault upon the daughter of first informant i.e. the prosecutrix namely- X, aged about 16 years.
sentences._hearing_file: Abhishek vs State Of U.P. And 3 Others on 15 December, 2023.json

sentences.text: After aforesaid F.I.R. was lodged, Investigating Officer proceeded with statutory investigation of concerned case crime number in terms of Chapter XII Cr.P.C.
sentences._hearing_file: Abhishek vs State Of U.P. And 3 Others on 15 December, 2023.json

sentences.text: The statement of the prosecutrix was recorded under section 161 Cr.P.C.
sentences._hearing_file: Abhishek vs State Of U.P. And 3 Others on 15 December, 2023.json

sentences.text: Same is on record at page 26 of the paper book.
sentences._hearing_file: Abhishek vs State Of U.P. And 3 Others on 15 December, 2023.json

sentences.text: The prosecutrix in her aforesaid statement has not only supported the F.I.R. but has also detailed the manner of occurrence.
sentences._hearing_file: Abhishek vs State Of U.P. And 3 Others on 15 December, 2023.json

sentences.text:
The prosecutrix has further stated that upon shouts raised by her, two persons namely,
Meraj and Virendra came on the spot and witnessed the after effects of the occurrence.
sentences._hearing_file: Abhishek vs State Of U.P. And 3 Others on 15 December, 2023.json

sentences.text: Subsequent to above, prosecutrix was requested for her internal medical examination.
sentences._hearing_file: Abhishek vs State Of U.P. And 3 Others on 15 December, 2023.json

sentences.text: The prosecutrix in her statement before the Doctor, who medically examined her has rejoined her previous statement under section 161 Cr.P.C.
sentences._hearing_file: Abhishek vs State Of U.P. And 3 Others on 15 December, 2023.json

sentences.text: The Doctor who medically examined the prosecutrix did not find any signs on her body so as to denote commission of deliberate or forceful sexual assault.
sentences._hearing_file: Abhishek vs State Of U.P. And 3 Others on 15 December, 2023.json

sentences.text: However, with regard to the private part of the prosecutrix, no adverse opinion was expressed by the Doctor.
sentences._hearing_file: Abhishek vs State Of U.P. And 3 Others on 15 December, 2023.json

sentences.text: Ultimately, the statement of the prosecutrix was recorded under section 164 Cr.P.C., wherein the prosecutrix has re-iterated her previous statement under section 161 Cr.P.C.
sentences._hearing_file: Abhishek vs State Of U.P. And 3 Others on 15 December, 2023.json

sentences.text: Apart from above, certain samples were taken from the body of the prosecutrix for pathological examination.
sentences._hearing_file: Abhishek vs State Of U.P. And 3 Others on 15 December, 2023.json

sentences.text: The results of the same were found to be in negative.
sentences._hearing_file: Abhishek vs State Of U.P. And 3 Others on 15 December, 2023.json

sentences.text: Even in the supplementary medico legal report, the Doctor has stated that no signs of injury was found in the body of the prosecutrix, including genital organ.
sentences._hearing_file: Abhishek vs State Of U.P. And 3 Others on 15 December, 2023.json

sentences.text:
The Doctor opined as follows:
"Hymen- Old torn hymen"
sentences._hearing_file: Abhishek vs State Of U.P. And 3 Others on 15 December, 2023.json

sentences.text: During course of investigation, Investigating Officer also examined two witnesses named in the statement of the prosecutrix under section 161 Cr.P.C. namely, Neeraj and Virendra.
sentences._hearing_file: Abhishek vs State Of U.P. And 3 Others on 15 December, 2023.json

sentences.text: Their statments are on record at pages 60 and 61 of the paper book.
sentences._hearing_file: Abhishek vs State Of U.P. And 3 Others on 15 December, 2023.json

sentences.text: The aforesaid witnesses and the first informant have also supported the F.I.R.
sentences._hearing_file: Abhishek vs State Of U.P. And 3 Others on 15 December, 2023.json

sentences.text: Investigating Officer further recovered the School Leaving Certificate of the prosecutrix wherein her date of birth is recorded as 10.11.2006.
sentences._hearing_file: Abhishek vs State Of U.P. And 3 Others on 15 December, 2023.json

sentences.text: Occurrence giving rise to present proceedings is alleged to have occurred on 27.8.2023.
sentences._hearing_file: Abhishek vs State Of U.P. And 3 Others on 15 December, 2023.json

sentences.text: As such, the prosecutrix was aged about 16 years, 9 months and 17 days on the date of occurrence.
sentences._hearing_file: Abhishek vs State Of U.P. And 3 Others on 15 December, 2023.json

sentences.text: Investigating Officer, further examined the first informant and other witnesses under section 161 Cr.P.C.
sentences._hearing_file: Abhishek vs State Of U.P. And 3 Others on 15 December, 2023.json

sentences.text: Witnesses so examined have supported the F.I.R.
sentences._hearing_file: Abhishek vs State Of U.P. And 3 Others on 15 December, 2023.json

sentences.text:
On the basis of above and other material collected by Investigating Officer during course of investigation, he came to the conclusion that complicity of the named accused i.e.
applicant herein is established in the crime in question.
sentences._hearing_file: Abhishek vs State Of U.P. And 3 Others on 15 December, 2023.json

sentences.text: Accordingly he submitted the charge sheet dated 21.9.2023, whereby applicants have been charge- sheeted under sections 376 IPC and 3/4 POCSO Act.
sentences._hearing_file: Abhishek vs State Of U.P. And 3 Others on 15 December, 2023.json

sentences.text: 2 Learned counsel for applicant contends that though applicant is a named as well as charge sheeted accused yet he is liable to be enlarged on bail.
sentences._hearing_file: Abhishek vs State Of U.P. And 3 Others on 15 December, 2023.json

sentences.text: Though the prosecutrix in her statement under sections 161 and 164 Cr.P.C. has implicated the applicant for dislodging her modesty, deliberately and forcibly but the medical evidence does not support the ocular version of the occurrence.
sentences._hearing_file: Abhishek vs State Of U.P. And 3 Others on 15 December, 2023.json

sentences.text:
He,
therefore, contends that applicant is liable to be enlarged on bail.
sentences._hearing_file: Abhishek vs State Of U.P. And 3 Others on 15 December, 2023.json

sentences.text: Apart from above, it is also contended by learned counsel for applicant that applicant has been falsely and maliciously implicated in aforesaid case crime number.
sentences._hearing_file: Abhishek vs State Of U.P. And 3 Others on 15 December, 2023.json

sentences.text: Present criminal proceedings have been engineered on account of an ulterior motive.
sentences._hearing_file: Abhishek vs State Of U.P. And 3 Others on 15 December, 2023.json

sentences.text: The witnesses who are alleged to have witnessed the after effects of the occurrence are planted and tutored witness who have been cooked up on false advice.
sentences._hearing_file: Abhishek vs State Of U.P. And 3 Others on 15 December, 2023.json

sentences.text: Even otherwise, applicant is a man of clean antecedents inasmuch as he has no criminal history to his credit except the present one.
sentences._hearing_file: Abhishek vs State Of U.P. And 3 Others on 15 December, 2023.json

sentences.text: Applicant is in jail since 10.9.2023.
sentences._hearing_file: Abhishek vs State Of U.P. And 3 Others on 15 December, 2023.json

sentences.text: As such, he has undergone two months of incarceration.
sentences._hearing_file: Abhishek vs State Of U.P. And 3 Others on 15 December, 2023.json

sentences.text: Police report in terms of Section 173 (2) Cr.P.C. has already been submitted against applicant, as such, the entire evidence sought to be relied upon by prosecution against applicant stands crystalized.
sentences._hearing_file: Abhishek vs State Of U.P. And 3 Others on 15 December, 2023.json

sentences.text: However, upto this stage, no such, circumstance has emerged necessitating the custodial arrest of applicant during the pendency of trial.
sentences._hearing_file: Abhishek vs State Of U.P. And 3 Others on 15 December, 2023.json

sentences.text: It is thus urged that applicant is liable to be enlarged on bail.
sentences._hearing_file: Abhishek vs State Of U.P. And 3 Others on 15 December, 2023.json

sentences.text: In case the applicant is enlarged on bail, he shall not misuse the liberty of bail and shall co-operate with the trial.
sentences._hearing_file: Abhishek vs State Of U.P. And 3 Others on 15 December, 2023.json

sentences.text: Per contra, the learned A.G.A. has opposed the prayer for bail.
sentences._hearing_file: Abhishek vs State Of U.P. And 3 Others on 15 December, 2023.json

sentences.text: He submits that since applicant is a named as well as charge sheeted accused, therefore he does not deserve any indulgence by this Court.
sentences._hearing_file: Abhishek vs State Of U.P. And 3 Others on 15 December, 2023.json

sentences.text: He contends that though the medical evidence does not support the ocular version of the occurrence yet the prosecution of applicant can still be maintained.
sentences._hearing_file: Abhishek vs State Of U.P. And 3 Others on 15 December, 2023.json

sentences.text: To buttress his submission he has referred to the judgement of Supreme court in Phool Singh Vs. State of M.P. (2022) 2 SCC 74.

sentences.text:
Since the prosecutrix in her statement under sections 161/164 Cr.P.C. has remained clear,
categorical and consistent i.e. unambiguous, therefore the said statements are worthy of credit.
sentences._hearing_file: Abhishek vs State Of U.P. And 3 Others on 15 December, 2023.json

sentences.text: The submissions urged by learned counsel for applicant regarding false and malicious prosecution of applicant on account of an ulterior motive, is a fanciful doubt inasmuch as no factual foundation exists on record regarding the same.
sentences._hearing_file: Abhishek vs State Of U.P. And 3 Others on 15 December, 2023.json

sentences.text: There is nothing on record to infer the innocence of applicant either.
sentences._hearing_file: Abhishek vs State Of U.P. And 3 Others on 15 December, 2023.json

sentences.text: As such, no sympathy be shown by this Court in favour of applicant.
sentences._hearing_file: Abhishek vs State Of U.P. And 3 Others on 15 December, 2023.json

sentences.text: When confronted with above, the learned counsel for applicant could not overcome the same.
sentences._hearing_file: Abhishek vs State Of U.P. And 3 Others on 15 December, 2023.json

sentences.text: Having heard the learned counsel for applicant, the learned A.G.A. for State, upon perusal of material brought on record, evidence, nature and gravity of offence as well as complicity of applicant, accusation made coupled with the fact that objections raised by the learned A.G.A. in opposition to the present application for bail could not be dislodged by learned counsel for applicant, therefore irrespective of the varied submissions urged by learned counsel for applicant in support of the present application for bail, but without making any comment on the merits of the case, this Court does not find any good or sufficient ground to enlarge the applicant on bail.
sentences._hearing_file: Abhishek vs State Of U.P. And 3 Others on 15 December, 2023.json

sentences.text: In view of above, the application fails and is liable to be rejected.
sentences._hearing_file: Abhishek vs State Of U.P. And 3 Others on 15 December, 2023.json

opennyai_summary.15_December_2023__arguments:
Present criminal proceedings have been engineered on account of an ulterior motive.
Even otherwise, applicant is a man of clean antecedents inasmuch as he has no criminal history to his credit except the present one.
Applicant is in jail since 10.9.2023.

To buttress his submission he has referred to the judgement of Supreme court in Phool Singh Vs. State of M.P. (2022) 2 SCC 74.
Since the prosecutrix in her statement under sections 161/164 Cr.P.C. has remained clear,
categorical and consistent i.e. unambiguous, therefore the said statements are worthy of credit.
The submissions urged by learned counsel for applicant regarding false and malicious prosecution of applicant on account of an ulterior motive, is a fanciful doubt inasmuch as no factual foundation exists on record regarding the same.
Having heard the learned counsel for applicant, the learned A.G.A. for State, upon perusal of material brought on record, evidence, nature and gravity of offence as well as complicity of applicant, accusation made coupled with the fact that objections raised by the learned A.G.A. in opposition to the present application for bail could not be dislodged by learned counsel for applicant, therefore irrespective of the varied submissions urged by learned counsel for applicant in support of the present application for bail, but without making any comment on the merits of the case, this Court does not find any good or sufficient ground to enlarge the applicant on bail.
opennyai_summary.15_December_2023__ANALYSIS:
There is nothing on record to infer the innocence of applicant either.
As such, no sympathy be shown by this Court in favour of applicant.
When confronted with above, the learned counsel for applicant could not overcome the same.

In view of above, the application fails and is liable to be rejected.
